description: ADR-0555 conversion pin (FRIC-1781330000): unowned is baseline-block-on-new in the armed (post-merge-base-advance) configuration. A PR adds a NEW file with no OWNERS-resolvable owner and the settle regen carries it into both current and proposed. Against the frozen merge-base reference the new key is a compare-mode regression (FAIL — with the remediation naming the exact registration edit) AND un-signed-off ratchet growth. The pre-existing unowned debt (the grandfathered key set) stays tolerated; only the NEW unaccounted artifact is unmergeable.

unowned.remediation: add an OWNERS file in the artifact's directory (or nearest ancestor) naming the owning team
